MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The outdoor VELCRO tape felt useful for attaching lightweight accessories when I want removable fastening alongside my screw-based projects.",
    "The J-B Weld epoxy fits occasional rigid repairs where screws alone would not work. The small Gorilla epoxy also suits that need, though I would choose only J-B Weld this time."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Locking nuts and a replacement power-tool switch serve specific needs I have not shown; buying framing nails and wood screws does not mean I need bolt hardware or tool repairs.",
    "The fuel cans do not connect to any current task, and the mixed decorating kit does not match my interest in screw-in drywall anchors.",
    "Ten tubes of glue and eighteen rolls of tape are excessive for my occasional repair needs, even if the products could sometimes be useful."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in construction fasteners seems to have been stretched into a broad interest in workshop supplies.",
    "Different ways of attaching things seem to have been treated as interchangeable, despite differences in strength, surface, removability, and purpose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The particular fastener sizes and types in my recent activity matter because they must fit the job; a general hardware connection is not enough.",
    "Package quantity matters: a small repair product can suit me while a bulk supply of a similar product does not.",
    "My vacuum-bag purchase reflects a separate replacement need, not evidence that I am shopping for every kind of maintenance supply."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my fastening and repair needs but extended them too broadly to unrelated equipment and oversized supplies."
}
